title: LCM on Whiteboard
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 1 \leq N \leq 2 \times 10^5; 1 \leq m_i; \sum{m_i} \leq 2 \times 10^5; 2 \leq p_{i,1} \lt \ldots \lt p_{i,m_i} \leq 10^9; p_{i,j} is prime.; 1 \leq e_{i,j} \leq 10^9; All values in input are integers.
